_owner: P8 (floor_life.dm). Tenant businesses per outpost, the note under a new floor's door, and the lines of tenants' people, movers and fitters. Placeholders: {name}, {other}, {place}; {business} for tenants' people; {outpost}, {floor}, {holder} in notes.
